posts.author: cacamarx
posts.body:
Hi everyone! I'm having an issue with my game. There are no random encounters while walking—only visible enemies on the map. When the player defeats an enemy, it turns into a slimy puddle. I achieved this by creating an event that follows the player and triggers a battle with one of my troops. If the player wins, a self-switch is activated, which changes the event to the next page. On this page, the enemy sprite is replaced with the slimy puddle, and the event stops following the player.
I've seen many threads where people wanted their event not to reactivate when leaving and reentering a map. One common solution is using the self-switch trick. In my case, I need the self-switch to turn enemies into puddles when defeated, but I also need them to reset when the player quits and reenters a map. How can I achieve this?

Self Switch Script call for multiple events on a map
Hi All,  I need to use $gameSelfSwitches.setValue([$gameMap._mapId, EVENTID, 'A'], false);  But for EVENTID I was hoping to use an array of multiple event IDs so I don't have to redo that code for multiple events. Something like this, but you know, done correctly: var E = [1,5,9, etc.]...
